text:
Jon: Heads-up — planning a routing policy update to shift ~15% of EU traffic to APAC edge for capacity smoothing tomorrow 2026-03-18 09:00 UTC. Who can own the deploy and smoke checks?
Priya: I can own end-to-end. Alex + Maria will be the hands-on deployers. I’ll stay on-watch for the first 45m.
Alex: I’ll be primary for the routing change. Will push the new policy, watch router metrics, and roll weights back if error budget spikes.
Maria: I’ll handle DNS TTL changes and watch propagation. Plan: drop TTL -> 60s at T-30m, restore to 300s after 30m stable.
Tara: I’ll run the synthetic smoke suite and look at latency p50/p95 across EU regions. I can kick off the smoke runs at T+2m and T+15m.
Jon: Sweet. Can we list the exact smoke checklist here so oncall can follow if someone gets paged?
Priya: Checklist: 1) confirm TTL lowered, 2) apply routing policy (policy id: rp-eu-apac-2026-03), 3) verify routing weight change in control plane, 4) run smoke suite, 5) check 5xx rate and latency, 6) if any step fails -> rollback.
Alex: Adding quick health checks (commands for oncall):
```
# check control plane view
curl -sS https://console.redwood-internal/api/routing/policies/rp-eu-apac-2026-03 | jq .weights
# spot-check edge health
curl -sS "https://eu-edge-01.internal/healthz" | grep OK
# run synthetic smoke (devex)
python tools/smoke/run_smoke.py --suite=eu-basic --target=eu-edge
```
Maria: DNS note: provider supports weighted records; we’ll only adjust weights via control plane, not manual DNS records. TTL change scheduled at 08:30 UTC (T-30m). I’ll post confirmation when TTL is in effect.
ops-oncall: ops-oncall here — FYI I’ll be watching alerts channel and can trigger rollback if error threshold > 0.8% 5xx over 5m or latency p95 > 1200ms for EU.
deploy-bot: deploy-bot: scheduled window reserved: 2026-03-18 09:00-09:30 UTC. Canary shard enabled (10% for first 2 minutes).
Priya: Rollback plan: 1) revert to previous policy version rp-eu-apac-2026-02, 2) restore DNS weights to prior snapshot (pre-change), 3) increase TTL back to 300s after stability, 4) open incident channel if rollback triggered.
Jon: If nobody objects, I’ll send the announce to #customer-notice at 08:45 UTC. Any last blockers?
Alex: No blockers from infra. Maria will confirm TTL; Tara will confirm smoke passes.
Maria: TTL lowered to 60s — confirmed at 08:30 UTC.
Tara: Smoke at T+2m passed (basic checks green). Monitoring shows a small p95 bump but within thresholds.
ops-oncall: Watching metrics, all green so far. Standby for 30m watch.
Priya: Thanks team — we’re set. I’ll do the handoff to on-call at T+30m if stable. :thumbsup:
